---
description: Extract acceptance test cases from OpenSpec specifications in Gherkin format into one .md YAML file per Jira/Xray Test artifact under /tests/, linked bidirectionally with /requirements/.
---

Invoke the `openspec-extract-tests` skill and follow its instructions to extract OpenSpec test scenarios into `/tests/*.md` (YAML + Gherkin for Jira/Xray) and synchronize bidirectional traceability links with `/requirements/`.
